subject.title: feat: open Control UI links in a macOS sidebar browser

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor an in-app macOS sidebar browser for external Control UI HTTP(S) links, or keep the current default-browser behavior?
rationale: This adds a new native/web product surface for external content inside the macOS app, and the protected `maintainer` label means automation should not choose or queue the implementation direction.

options.title: Sponsor scoped two-phase implementation
options.body: Proceed with the issue's split plan: first review the dormant Control UI bridge, then add the macOS WKWebView sidebar with explicit controls and proof.

options.title: Keep default-browser behavior
options.body: Decline the in-app browser direction and keep external links leaving the macOS dashboard through the user's default browser.

options.title: Request design and security spike
options.body: Ask for a minimal prototype and external-content security notes before accepting the product direction for arbitrary pages in the app.

recommendation.title: Sponsor scoped two-phase implementation
recommendation.body: Proceed with the issue's split plan: first review the dormant Control UI bridge, then add the macOS WKWebView sidebar with explicit controls and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the issue, owns the related bridge proposal, and has recent macOS dashboard history.
